user.title: Installation
user.description: Planner output and outdoor unit. Indoor units are added one by one afterwards (“Add indoor unit”).

help_plan_entity.name: Help: Planned power (planner outputs)
help_plan_entity.description: One or more sensors of the energy planner with the planned electrical power of the air conditioner. Usually the planned flow of the HAEO connection house → 'Klima' (`sensor.klima_power_source_target`); with two power stages both connections, which are summed. State = power now in W or kW, attribute `forecast` = list of `time`/`value` entries for the coming hours. If one sensor is unavailable or the plan is older than the maximum plan age (options), the fallback applies: all indoor units heat to their standard setpoint.

help_p_min_w.name: Help: Pmin (smallest continuous power)
help_p_min_w.description: Smallest electrical power the outdoor unit can hold continuously without cycling. While running, at least Pmin is requested; a surplus over the plan goes into the buffer. Start and stop threshold are shares of Pmin (default 80 % and 50 %). Example: Pmin 1300 W → start from 1040 W planned, stop below 650 W.

help_p_max_w.name: Help: Pmax (largest power)
help_p_max_w.description: Largest electrical power the outdoor unit draws at full load, e.g. from the data sheet or the highest measured power. It is the upper limit for the planned power: the sensor 'Max charge power' passes it to the planner as the maximum of the connection house → air conditioner.

help_stage1_w.name: Help: Power stage 1
help_stage1_w.description: Limit of the first power stage in the planner model. Up to this power the planner plans without surcharge; the second stage (Pmax − stage 1) carries the stage 2 surcharge (options) because the unit works less efficiently there. Only needed for the optional HAEO extension with two power stages; with a single connection the limit is Pmax.

help_capacity_kwh_per_k.name: Help: Buffer capacity per kelvin
help_capacity_kwh_per_k.description: Heat storage capacity of the building as electrical energy per kelvin of room temperature (kWh_el/K). The buffer capacity given to the planner is this value times the width of the SOC scale (default 15 K). Rough estimate: thermal capacity of the building divided by the heat pump's coefficient of performance.

error.no_plan: Select at least one planner sensor.

help_entity_id.name: Help: Indoor unit
help_entity_id.description: The air conditioner of this room. Only the temperature reported by this unit counts as room temperature (whole degrees); room sensors are not used. Each indoor unit can be configured only once per installation.

help_setpoint_c.name: Help: Setpoint (fixed or substitute value)
help_setpoint_c.description: The room's own setpoint. Reference for the deviation (priority), the SOC (worst room against its own setpoint), the hard minimum (setpoint − 2 K → heat even without plan), overheating (setpoint + 3 K for 1 h → cool) and the fallback (heat to this value). If a setpoint entity is set below, this value is only used while the entity delivers no valid value.

help_setpoint_entity.name: Help: Setpoint entity (optional)
help_setpoint_entity.description: Optional number helper, number or sensor whose value (°C) is used as the setpoint instead of the fixed value, e.g. to change setpoints by automation or schedule. The value is read in every control cycle; values outside 5–30 °C, unavailable or non-numeric states are ignored and the fixed setpoint applies. Leave empty for a fixed setpoint.

help_power_class.name: Help: Power class
help_power_class.description: Free name for units with the same nominal power, e.g. 'small' or 'large'. When deviations are tied, units are grouped by power class and switched on group by group so that the load rises evenly. Order of the classes = order in which they first appear among the indoor units.

help_nominal_power_w.name: Help: Nominal power
help_nominal_power_w.description: Electrical power this indoor unit roughly draws at the outdoor unit while heating. It decides how many units run for the requested power: groups are added until their sum covers the request.

help_area_m2.name: Help: Area
help_area_m2.description: Weight of the room in the lower bounds for the planner: the lower bound is the area-weighted mean of the setpoints, so large rooms count more.

help_window_entity.name: Help: Window contact
help_window_entity.description: Optional window contact (on = open). While the window is open the room is taken out of the control: the unit goes to the neutral mode and counts neither for the SOC nor for the distribution.

help_start_ratio.name: Help: Start threshold (share of Pmin)
help_start_ratio.description: A stopped outdoor unit starts only when the plan shows at least this share of Pmin. Below, the plan is ignored and all units stay neutral. Default 0.8 (80 %).

help_stop_ratio.name: Help: Stop threshold (share of Pmin)
help_stop_ratio.description: A running outdoor unit keeps running until the plan falls below this share of Pmin; there is no pulse operation in between. Must not be larger than the start threshold. Default 0.5 (50 %).

help_tie_band_k.name: Help: Tie band (K)
help_tie_band_k.description: Deviations (setpoint − device temperature) less than this apart count as equal. Equal rooms are served together, grouped by power class. Default 1 K (resolution of the units).

help_heat_offset_k.name: Help: Heating offset above device temperature (K)
help_heat_offset_k.description: A served unit gets its device temperature plus this offset as setpoint (at most the overload limit). A larger offset means more power per unit. Default 1 K.

help_soc_smoothing_s.name: Help: SOC smoothing (s)
help_soc_smoothing_s.description: Time window for smoothing the SOC (median of the values within the window). Default 900 s (15 min).

help_outlier_k.name: Help: Outlier limit per cycle (K)
help_outlier_k.description: If a device temperature jumps by more than this within one cycle, the value is discarded. If the next cycle confirms the new value, it is accepted. Default 2 K.

help_overheat_k.name: Help: Overheating above setpoint (K)
help_overheat_k.description: A room at least this much above its setpoint counts as overheated. Default 3 K.

help_overheat_s.name: Help: Overheating duration (s)
help_overheat_s.description: How long a room must be overheated before it is cooled. Cooling only happens while no unit heats. Default 3600 s (1 h).

help_hard_min_below_k.name: Help: Hard minimum below setpoint (K)
help_hard_min_below_k.description: Hard minimum = setpoint minus this value. Below it the room is heated even without plan. It is also the lower end of the penalty zone in the planner model. Default 2 K.

help_overload_max_c.name: Help: Overload limit (°C)
help_overload_max_c.description: Highest room temperature up to which the buffer may be charged (overload with surcharge). Units at or above it are no longer served, setpoints are capped to it. Default 28 °C.

help_comfort_max_c.name: Help: Upper bound without surcharge (°C)
help_comfort_max_c.description: Upper bound without surcharge in the planner model. Between this value and the overload limit the planner applies the overload surcharge. Must lie between SOC scale 0 % and the overload limit. Default 24 °C (assumption, not fixed in the functional spec).

help_soc_min_c.name: Help: SOC scale 0 % (°C)
help_soc_min_c.description: Temperature of the worst room that corresponds to 0 % SOC. Default 15 °C.

help_soc_max_c.name: Help: SOC scale 100 % (°C)
help_soc_max_c.description: Temperature of the worst room that corresponds to 100 % SOC. Default 30 °C.

help_efficiency_pct.name: Help: Buffer efficiency (%)
help_efficiency_pct.description: Efficiency of the climate buffer in the planner model (losses while storing heat). Default 92 %.

help_discharge_limit_w.name: Help: Buffer discharge limit (W)
help_discharge_limit_w.description: Highest discharge power of the buffer in the planner model, i.e. how fast the house loses heat. Default 3500 W.

help_night_start_h.name: Help: Night setback start (hour)
help_night_start_h.description: Full hour (local time) at which the night setback starts. Only the lower bounds for the planner are lowered. Default 21.

help_night_end_h.name: Help: Night setback end (hour)
help_night_end_h.description: Full hour (local time) at which the night setback ends. Default 6.

help_night_setback_k.name: Help: Night setback of lower bounds (K)
help_night_setback_k.description: Lower bound and hard minimum for the planner are lowered by this much at night. The protection of the hard minimum in the room stays unchanged. Default 1 K (assumption, not fixed in the functional spec).

help_late_charge_surcharge.name: Help: Late charge surcharge (per kWh)
help_late_charge_surcharge.description: Small amount per kWh that falls linearly to 0 over the forecast horizon. It only decides between equally priced time windows: then the planner charges later (less storage loss). Default 0.001.

help_undercharge_cost.name: Help: Penalty between setpoint and hard minimum (per kWh)
help_undercharge_cost.description: Penalty per kWh when the planner discharges the buffer between setpoint and hard minimum. Default 0.003 (slightly below that of the car charging).

help_overcharge_cost.name: Help: Overload surcharge (per kWh)
help_overcharge_cost.description: Surcharge per kWh for charging between the upper bound without surcharge and the overload limit. Default 0.003 (assumption, not fixed in the functional spec).

help_stage2_surcharge.name: Help: Power stage 2 surcharge (per kWh)
help_stage2_surcharge.description: Surcharge per kWh for power above stage 1. Default 0.001 (assumption, not fixed in the functional spec).

help_planner_horizon_h.name: Help: Planner forecast horizon (h)
help_planner_horizon_h.description: Number of hours in the forecasts of the planner values. Should be at least the planner's horizon. Default 24.

help_plan_max_age_s.name: Help: Maximum plan age (s)
help_plan_max_age_s.description: If the plan has not been updated for longer than this, it counts as outdated and the fallback applies (all units heat to their standard setpoint). Default 1800 s.

help_neutral_mode.name: Help: Neutral mode
help_neutral_mode.description: Mode of units that are not served; it separates heating and cooling. Fan (default) keeps the device temperature meaningful, off saves the fan power (about 85 W for seven units).

help_cycle_s.name: Help: Control cycle (s)
help_cycle_s.description: Interval between control cycles. Each cycle reads plan and device temperatures, decides and sends only changed commands to the indoor units. Shorter intervals react faster but send more commands. Default 60 s.

config_entry_id.name: Installation
config_entry_id.description: Only this installation. Empty = all installations.
